# Independent audit: ambient-simplex endpoint-centroid midpoint failure

**PASS.** Read the complete source
candidate 64c5bdbc0c6d6575 and its
exact verifier, and reran the latter: PASS 116 checks.

The full-dimensional vertex determinant is 4, so the ambient
six-volume is 1/180. The barycentric normal form fixes the original
integer base and gives precisely the displayed fibers. The base-zero
face has dimension two and base four is a singleton; both are null
for the stated full five-dimensional mixed measure. Bases 1,2,3
are interior projection levels and have positive full fiber volume.

The confluent slice formula agrees with the independently audited
calculus source and yields raw density values 139/288,1/2,1/32.
Their total and normalized nonheavy weights are exactly 73/72 and
(139,144,9)/292. Boundary values are zero here, so no positive
endpoint fiber is silently omitted.

The exact equality K2=(K1+K3)/2 also checks. Any vertex of the slab
C intersect {1<=z<=3} not on its two clipping planes would have to
be an original simplex vertex. No original vertex has height
strictly between 1 and 3. The slab is therefore the convex hull of
its two boundary fibers, giving the stated midpoint equality.

The duplicated-knot barycentric moments reproduce both endpoint
centroids and the candidate (7). In particular lambda_*(g1)=241/3336,
lambda_*(g3)=35/72, and their midpoint value is 1397/5004>1/4.
This candidate has base two and belongs to the actual middle fiber.

The cap lambda_*>=1/4 is an actual oblique halfspace strictly
containing the candidate. In its homothetic cap formula, only
integer bases 2 and 3 contribute positive volume, at original
slice arguments 4/3 and 8/3. The arguments at bases 1 and 4 are
zero-volume endpoints and are treated correctly. The exact cap
mass is (559/3072)V and its normalized value is 1677/9344. The
absolute deficit below Gamma5 M/2 is (48739/2239488)V>0.
The sharper through-candidate cap also verifies, but is not needed
for the obstruction.

The distinct own-middle centroid has the displayed seven positive
barycentric coordinates, summing to one with height moment two.
All seven upper canonical cap values in the table verify exactly
and lie between Gamma5/2 and 1-Gamma5/2. Each barycentric coordinate
has a nonzero continuous linear part, so the complementary cap
mass is exactly one minus that value. This checks all fourteen
claimed orientations, without extending them to arbitrary caps.

The conclusion is correctly scoped: it refutes the single
endpoint-centroid midpoint selector even with exact midpoint
compatibility and an ambient-simplex source. It neither refutes OC
nor proves the own-middle centroid safe against every direction.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
